verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a $99/year registered-agent rate and the option to buy multiple years at that rate, which partly documents recurring renewal charges. Nothing in the evidence covers cancellation, refunds, auto-renewal behavior, or how to transfer an entity out to another agent. The 'avoid double paying' note is about switching in to Harbor, not leaving, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: cancellation terms, transfer-out/registered-agent change process, auto-renewal and refund policy, renewal pricing beyond the registered-agent product, independent corroboration.
